headline: Brazilian Asset Managers Emet and B.Real Launch R$ 120M Fund for Data Centers
summary: Asset managers Emet and B.Real created a R$ 120 million fund to develop data center projects in Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo, and Ceará, with total investments projected at R$ 1 billion.
why: Growing demand for cloud computing and artificial intelligence infrastructure is driving significant private equity and venture capital investment into data center real estate.

impacts.name: Brazilian data center sector
impacts.why: New capital funds directly drive infrastructure development and real estate investment.
